description: This bar chart illustrates task counts for different linguistic categories across three conditions: mBERT, XLM-R, and instances where performance was the “same” between the models. The horizontal axis displays the linguistic categories—IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic—listed in that order. The vertical axis represents “task count,” with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 40, with tick marks every 10 units. For each category, there are three adjacent bars representing the task counts for mBERT (light blue), XLM-R (dark blue), and “same” (light green). In the IE-Baltic category, the mBERT bar is approximately 8, the XLM-R bar is approximately 16, and the “same” bar is approximately 10. The IE-Germanic category shows an mBERT bar of approximately 4, an XLM-R bar of approximately 20, and a “same” bar of approximately 18. The IE-Slavic category has the tallest bars, with mBERT at approximately 10, XLM-R exceeding 40, and “same” at approximately 6. The bars are not sorted, and no bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
caption_used: The bar chart compares task counts across linguistic categories for mBERT and XLM-R models, alongside tasks where performance was the same. The horizontal axis lists categories: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The vertical axis represents task count, ranging from 0 to 40. In the IE-Baltic category, XLM-R consistently outperforms mBERT, with task counts exceeding 15. IE-Germanic shows a notable decline in mBERT performance, with task counts below 5, while XLM-R and 'same' are roughly equal at around 20. IE-Slavic demonstrates the highest task count for XLM-R, surpassing 45, while mBERT remains stable at approximately 10 tasks. The Isolate category exhibits minimal variation, with all models performing similarly at around 5 tasks. The legend, located in the top right, clarifies the color coding for mBERT (light blue), XLM-R (dark blue), and 'same' (light green).
